title: Five Plays: Wake Forest Second Quarter

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Five Plays: Wake Forest Second Quarter
sources.description: The second quarter of Louisville’s game against Wake Forest may just be the worst quarter of football Jeff Brohm has seen from his defense during his time here. Blown coverages, missed assignments, mental errors, missed tackles, and untimely penalties led to Wake absorbing what was a very good quarter from the Louisville offense. I clipped […]
